dedupe_keys.name: wecc anchor data set 2034 hydropower generation data sets

description: These data sets give plant-level hydropower generation and flexibility for the Western Electricity Coordinating Council (WECC) Anchor Data Set 2034, the case WECC releases every two years for production cost modelling of loads, resources and transmission ten years ahead. They were developed by Pacific Northwest National Laboratory with Nathalie Voisin and co-authors, following the ADS 2032 data set. They cover the whole US WECC footprint and a new Canadian extension synchronised to the 2018 weather year, with weekly and monthly generation and flexibility by plant and unit, Columbia River operations from Bonneville Power Administration modelling under 2023 environmental rules, and 16 facilities moved from fixed schedules to dispatchable. Files are CSV tables for US weekly and monthly and Canadian monthly data, plus PNNL reports as PDFs, on Zenodo (version 3.2.1, May 2025) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: proprietary member data and ramping data were used but not released, and Canadian Peace River facilities were not updated. Simulation uses are production cost modelling and resource adequacy studies of the Western Interconnection. Related records: data-godeeep-hydro-power-system-ready-hydropower uses related methods for the US fleet.
